title: WRCC2023_MI_C: Three-class motor imagery dataset from the World Robot Contest 2023 (MI-C)
description: A three-class motor imagery EEG dataset (left hand, right hand, feet) from the MI-C track of the 2023 World Robot Contest BCI competition. It contains recordings from 8 participants, including 2 stroke patients, with 90 cue-based trials each. Data were recorded with a 59-channel EEG system at 1000 Hz and re-released in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuracle NeuSen W 64-channel wireless system (59 EEG channels used, 1000 Hz sampling rate, 50 Hz line frequency). Participants performed cue-based offline motor imagery of left hand, right hand, or feet, with 30 trials per class and 4 s epochs.
